Subject: Launching evaluation roadmap & weekly check-ins — Week 1

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, this thread is to lock in the evaluation roadmap and a lightweight weekly checkpoint cadence so we can close the pilot by the end of Q3. High-level proposal below — please flag anything you want changed.

Objective
- Validate latency and cost at 50k requests/day profile, verify query-level quality on the 3 acceptance prompts you provided, and confirm the integration path for your staging environment.

Proposed cadence (30-minute standing)
- Frequency: Weekly, Thursdays 10:00–10:30 AM PT (first session: 2026-08-26)
- Attendees: Laura (Product), ACME engineering lead (rotating), Olga (Sales), Marcus (Solutions), Neha (CS)
- Goal for week 1: Align success criteria, confirm access/credentials for staging, and run baseline sample through Redwood hosted endpoint.

Success criteria (initial)
- Latency: median <= 250ms token latency for typical prompts
- Cost: projected per-1k-token cost within agreed range in the MAP
- Quality: >= 85% pass on your acceptance prompt set (will use the shared eval harness)

Next steps / asks from ACME
1) Share a staging API key or allow our IPs (ACME-technical) to access the staging endpoint — target: by 2026-08-24.
2) Confirm who will own engineering tickets for integration (name/email).
3) Review the attached MAP draft (map_draft_v1.pdf) and leave comments in the linked Drive doc.

I attached a rough MAP draft and a one-page checklist so we can iterate quickly. Marcus and Neha will cover testing and adoption signals. If the time above works, I’ll send a calendar invite for Thursdays.

Thanks — looking forward to a fast ramp.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Sales
Redwood Inference
